county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Pre-service Training- Developmental Stages (26 TAC §746.1305(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have pre service training hours. Caregiver did not have previous child care service experience.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not Licensed (26 TAC §HRC42.041(a) - Illegal Operation - Not L)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation is operating prior to receiving their permit.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.

top_violation_types.title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver, with direct access to children, was present without a background check eligibility.  The caregiver was sent home during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Ensure total number of children both at & away from center within capacity (26 TAC §746.201(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the inspection, there were 11 infants in care and the total capacity for infants in the permit is 10.
